digimons.name: Ragnamon
digimons.description:
An Ultimate that boasts the largest size among Digimon. Having taken in the data of an artificial satellite, it possesses a variety of satellite weapons that are enough to annihilate vast areas of ​​the Digital World from high above. However, it requires a large amount of resources to operate, necessitating the support of proficient hackers, so there are few records of it appearing on the battlefield.



Its Special Moves are "Gimlet Gun", in which it pierces with its tail, "Spaser", in which it fires an enormous laser from its head, "Shuttle Scissors", in which it seizes the enemy with its right arm and severs them, "Satellite Buster", in which it picks off distant enemies with the gun barrels on its shoulders, and "Ragnarök Cannon", which is fired from its chest, providing maximum offensive power. In addition, whenever it receives an attack from the enemy, it analyzes it, and is capable of unleashing that attack's power back at them.

digimons.name: Raguelmon
digimons.description:
An Ultimate level Digimon who observes all Angel Digimon with eyes of distrust, in order to prevent the fall of other Angel Digimon. The moment it detects an Angel Digimon that has begun to fall, it will attack and destroy them before they would have fallen completely. However, because it was shunned for its role as an observer, it began to be filled with nihilistic thoughts until its sole line of thought was to reject everything. At that stage, it no longer discerns between friend and foe, turning into a fearsome Digimon that carries out destruction indiscriminately.



Its Special Move is mutilating the enemy using the claws on its arms and the tip of its tail (Form Taranis). Once it impales the enemy, it injects destructive data that eat away at and corrode the enemy from the inside. It can also fire laser bullets from the gemstones situated on its arms and chest (Purhorus).

digimons.name: Raidenmon
digimons.description: A heavyweight-class Machine type Digimon equipped with electromagnetic weapons. It was created as a shooting-type, unlike Raijinmon, who similarly uses lightning as its energy. Although it is not as adept in close combat, it defends itself using its thick armor, and counterattacks with its left arm. Its Special Moves are causing a corona discharge brought upon by a 45000-volt electric attack (Kirlian Brand), and firing ultra-high temperature spheres from the gun barrels on both of its shoulders (Rising Sun).

digimons.name: Raijinmon
digimons.description: A Cyborg Digimon bestowed with the name of the Raijin of Oriental folklore. A fighting-type that is strong in close combat, its Signature Move is "Blitz Arm", in which it dishes out a barrage of punches with the same lightning-type arm as Justimon. Its Special Move is charging with the connector on its tail, and firing intense lightning from its shoulders into its surroundings (Elekugel).

digimons.name: Rapidmon (X-Antibody)
digimons.description:
A Holy Knight Digimon that Armor Evolved from Terriermon with the "Digimental of Fate". Rapidmon is normally a Perfect which evolves from Galgomon, but thanks to the "Digimental of Fate", it is able to shine gold and sublimate power up to the Ultimate Level. Its Special Moves are rapid-firing homing missiles from both of its arms and the revolver equipped to its back (Rapid Fire), and "Golden Triangle", which is similar in power level to Magnamon's Special Move, "Extreme Jihad".



The effect on Rapidmon's Digicore due to the X-Antibody



The power contained within the Digimental of Fate has been drawn out even further by the X-Antibody, and it is now capable of constantly exhibiting power at the Ultimate Level. The armaments on both of its arms and back form the "Armed Arms"; it rapid-fires its "Rapid Blaster", which has a low attenuation rate, at long-range, and its "Laser Gatling Arm", where it switches from the Armed Arms on its back, at close-to-mid-range. In addition, a booster function has also been added, allowing it to dive into the enemy's chest at high speed, and slash them with its claws.



Its greatest Special Move is detaching all of the Armed Arms, cornering the enemy by operating them remotely, and shooting them up with a billion bullets (Billion Bullet).

digimons.name: Rasenmon
digimons.description:
Rasenmon's true form, which it attained after accepting its negative emotions without fearing them and regaining the courage it needed to believe in itself. Having broken free of the negative emotions that shackled it down, it is now reborn into this new form and is able to completely control the power that drove it berserk in the past; its violent temperament has also faded, and it now sports a kind and gentle personality.



In battle, it is capable of amassing even more power by absorbing the energy derived from its allies' emotions; however, it is only able to use this ability to carry out actions it believes are right.



Its Special Moves are dishing out a powerful punch while spinning the blades on its arm (Gyro Smash), as well as spinning its blades at extremely high speed, creating tornadoes that strike the opponent (Qualialise Blast). Not only that, Rasenmon's "Spiral Vanish" move, in which it shoots out and fuses all of the spiral-shaped spines covering its body to form a gigantic drill which it uses to impale the opponent, is its trump card where it unleashes all of the emotion energy it has stored together with its drill to deliver a crushingly powerful blow.

digimons.name: Rasenmon: Fury Mode
digimons.description:
A ruthless, nine-tailed Ultimate Digimon that became unable to control its power of darkness when large amounts of negative emotion data flowed in from others while it was evolving from a Perfect Digimon. It is a destroyer that gave in to its rampaging power of darkness when it finished evolving, instinctively devastating its surroundings. It suffers from inner conflict stemming from its fear of and attempts to reject the swirling negative emotions inside of itself, which gave rise to its destructive impulses and subsequently its vicious personality.



Its Special Moves are extending its large, spiral-shaped tails and skewering the opponent over and over again (Desperate Vortex), and pouncing on the opponent, devouring their Digicore directly (Predator's Bite). In addition, it indiscriminately attacks by rapidly spinning the blades on its wrists, tearing apart everything in their surroundings while generating tornadoes (Spiral Hell).

digimons.name: Rasielmon
digimons.description:
An Ophan Digimon that was once appointed to the same rank as Ofanimon. It possesses the mysterious power to foresee everything in the world from the "Kernel" (God's domain). It is said that it knows all about events throughout the Digital World, and has gained a divine amount of knowledge with that power.



Its Special Moves are freely combining the five elements from the magic circles on its arms and releasing enormous energy (Knowledge Stream). And, as for its "Sefer Raziel", which brings about all kinds of miracles to exterminate the adversary, not even Rasielmon itself knows what will happen.

digimons.name: Ravmon
digimons.description: A Cyborg Digimon which possesses a wing made of Chrome Digizoid. At the Genesis of the Digital World, it was a Digimon that served under a certain God Man Digimon and was titled the "Silver Crow", but it is said that it was touched by that god's anger and one of its wings was dyed black. The true terror of Ravmon is in its covert actions. It conceals its figure with its black wing, and slashes the opponent with its white wing. Suddenly appearing out of nowhere, it brings down the opponent in a single blow. Its Special Moves are raising the sharp nails on its left arm and then performing a rotating rush at the opponent (Spiral Raven Claw), and cutting the opponent to pieces with its left wing (Blast Wing). Also, it strikes the opponent with the sword "Chouou-maru" which it unleashes with nimble movements, and the blade of dark lightning which is released from the "Chouou-maru", "Ame-no-Ohabari", possesses tremendous destructive power.

digimons.name: Ravmon: Burst Mode
digimons.description: A Ravmon that has temporarily reached the limits of its abilities through Burst Evolution, it is a unique form which wears all the energy within the atmosphere as an aura. Its Special Moves are enlarging its wings to a gigantic size and releasing a dark purple aura (Musou-Tenshou-Yoku-no-Jin), and furiously performing a terrible and wild dance of violence (Dotou-Yami-Kumo-no-Mai). Also, it can stab the opponent in a flash of thunder with its dark purple aura (Raikou-Issen-no-Tsuki).

digimons.name: Regalecusmon
digimons.description:
An aloof Aquatic Digimon that hates crowds. It is a pirate who repeatedly assaults and plunders the feeding grounds and territories of other Digimon, and also the ruler of the abyss that stands at the apex of the food chain due to its overwhelming power. Its sword, which it made after tearing off a Zudomon's horn, and the giant pincer on its left arm are symbols of awe that strike fear into those who lay their eyes upon them.



Its Special Moves are piercing the enemy with the sword in its right hand, accompanied by a flash of lightning (Briona Strike), and blowing away everything around it, including seawater, with plasma discharged from its pincer (Reactor Discharge).

digimons.name: Rosemon (X-Antibody)
digimons.description:
A Fairy Digimon which has an appearance like the rose, which is called the Queen of Flowers. It has the form of a beautiful woman, and desires to remain beautiful forever. Its personality is more or less that way, and though it is excessively self-conscious about such things, its true strength does not in fact compare unfavorably with other Ultimates. Also, it wears on its breast a "Tiferet", a jewel which is engraved with the symbol of love and beauty. This Tiferet that it possesses is said to promise it eternal beauty and power. Its Special Move is taming Digimon, no matter how frenzied, with a thorned whip charged with electricity (Thorn Whip). It is said that those that suffer this technique become Rosemon's slave, body and soul.



The effect on Rosemon's Digicore due to the X-Antibody



Rosemon's vivid beauty has been drawn out, and its appearance, dyed a crimson so deep that it makes all other red objects look completely washed out, even gives an overwhelming sense of inferiority to those who see it. The "Aphroditear" droplets on its petals seen when incurring the wrath of Rosemon are said to be the tears of its love, and Digimon that lay their eyes on them are eventually annihilated by its Special Move "Rosen Blood", in which they personally embrace Rosemon's thorned whips despite knowing that they will get injured, taking damage.

digimons.name: Rosemon: Burst Mode
digimons.description: A Rosemon that has temporarily reached the limits of its abilities through Burst Evolution, it is a unique form which wears an aura of love and beauty. Its Special Moves are amplifying the aura of its mantle, gently wrapping it around the opponent, and then annihilating them (Charité), and releasing lasers of a blown kiss from its lips (Aguichant Lèvres). Also, it can shoot the "Tiferets" that it wears, jewels engraved with the symbol of love and beauty, at the opponent.

evolvesFrom.name: Lilamon
evolvesFrom.line: Lilamon[10] (with or without Rosemon, Babamon, Sunflowmon, and Lalamon[7])

digimons.name: Rust Tyranomon
digimons.description: The Ultimate of Tyranomon who has lived through the fierce, continuing battles that have lasted since the genesis of the Digital World, and evolved alongside it. Having endured many years in harsh environments as Metal Tyranomon, its whole cyborg body shows signs of rust. Its tactics are geared towards annihilation warfare, and it is capable of ravaging an entire enemy base by itself. Rust Tyranomon has the nature of a Digimon predator, gorging on hundreds of thousands of Digimon within a short period without leaving a trace. Its Special Moves are extending forth the battery on its back and firing its large-scale electromagnetic cannon (Terror's Cluster), and spewing deep scarlet flames, the same color as its body (Rust Breath). Its "Rust Breath" induces a rusting effect on whatever it touches. Even in close combat, it pins the opponent down with its power and destructive force, which are top-class among Cyborg Digimon.

digimons.name: Saint Galgomon
digimons.description: A colossal Machine Digimon whose whole body has become a mass of weapons. The amount of weapons it has equipped rivals that of Metal Garurumon (Incidentally, while Metal Garurumon uses cold-based weapons, Saint Galgomon uses heat-based weapons). Each of its weapons, such as its lasers, missiles, bazookas, vulcans, and flamethrowers, are concealed. Although its speed is considerably slow, because it puts all of that energy into power, it possesses unbelievable destructive force. Because its lack of speed is compensated for by its weapons, it is able to cope with attacks from every direction without moving even a little. Its Special Moves are a volley firing of its firearms (Burst Shot) and firing a gigantic megaton-class missile from the gun turrets on its shoulders (Giant Missile).

digimons.name: Sakuyamon
digimons.description: A Digimon that holds the role of a miko, acting as an agent of God's will. Like Taomon, it freely uses Onmyoudou techniques in battle, and has the ability to employ God Beast-species Digimon. It always carries four pipes on the belt around its waist, within which lurk four kuda-gitsune. It is able to use these kuda-gitsune for everything from attacking to gathering information. Just like Holy Angemon's Priest Mode, it is able to change into a Miko Mode which administers Shinto rituals. Its Signature Move is attacking the opponent with the four kuda-gitsune carried on its waist (Izuna). The four kuda-gitsune possess the attributes of "Fire", "Water", "Wind", and "Thunder", respectively. Its Special Move is striking the ground with its "Kongou Shakujou", spreading a purifying barrier that exorcises evil spirits (Kongoukai Mandara).

digimons.name: Sakuyamon (X-Antibody)
digimons.description:
A Digimon that holds the role of a miko, acting as an agent of God's will. Like Taomon, it freely uses Onmyoudou techniques in battle, and has the ability to employ God Beast-species Digimon. It always carries four pipes on the belt around its waist, within which lurk four kuda-gitsune. It is able to use these kuda-gitsune for everything from attacking to gathering information. Just like Holy Angemon's Priest Mode, it is able to change into a Miko Mode which administers Shinto rituals. Its Signature Move is attacking the opponent with the four kuda-gitsune carried on its waist (Izuna). The four kuda-gitsune possess the attributes of "Fire", "Water", "Wind", and "Thunder", respectively. Its Special Move is striking the ground with its "Kongou Shakujou", spreading a purifying barrier that exorcises evil spirits (Kongoukai Mandara).



The effect on Sakuyamon's Digicore due to the X-Antibody



Beginning with necromancy and Onmyoudou, it has grown into a specialist who has mastered every secret art that has been passed down throughout the eastern Digital World. By attuning itself closely to the Digital World's nature, it is able to transform various object data such as flora and rocks into shikigami in the shape of flowers or foxes, and order them to do its bidding. It is skilled in using its kuda-gitsune and shikigami for reconnaissance and espionage; acting as a watchman of the darkness, it strikes at its foes from the dark using the information it has obtained. Its new Special Moves are turning all of the objects around it into countless shikigami, enveloping the enemy in a storm of flowers and annihilating them (Konohanasenki-banshou), and fusing its four kuda-gitsune, which possess power over each of the four elements respectively, into a single gigantic fox spirit and summoning it (Uka-no-Mitama).

digimons.name: Shagaramon
digimons.description:
A Holy Dragon Digimon that resides in Ryushogu, an oceanic area in the Eastern Digital World where beautiful crystals grow. Using the cloth wrapped around its body and its ability to manipulate seawater, it is able to create ocean current gates that can transport anyone anywhere, and it is impossible to reach the secluded region of Ryushogu without riding the ocean currents generated by Shagaramon.



Since it has the duty of banishing any Digimon that disturbs the peace in Ryushogu upon arriving there, Shagaramon has been entrusted as the gatekeeper of Ryushogu by Ryugumon. The Digimon responsible for gatekeeping alongside it are Hangyomon and Mermaimon, and Shagaramon has the additional role of supervising the other gatekeepers.



It also has the ability to fly in the air, and can occasionally be seen soaring gracefully through the skies above Ryushogu's waters.



Its Special Moves are creating a huge wave-like fan and hurling it at the opponent (Rōtō Sen), and detonating small spheres of compressed seawater (Kankai Sakusōjin). Finally, its "Sōten Ryūjinga" devours the opponent with a dragon made from seawater.

digimons.name: Shin Monzaemon
digimons.description:
A Puppet Digimon that evolved as a result of Monzaemon taking in nightmare-related analysis data. At first glance, it is shaped like a teddy bear, but it is actually a fluffy, amorphous Digimon with a mysterious nature, like a cross between slime and clouds. It is a moody Digimon that has a childish personality and does not act intelligently. It has a habit of liking and taking in simple and cute things, and chooses immature Digimon that are Child-level and below as its targets. On the other hand, since it considers Digimon that have gotten more mature to be "repulsive beings with impurities mixed in with their data", it hates even getting close to them. When it feeds, it extends its soft wings to envelop its targets. Because its whole body is made up of powerful energy, weak Digimon are said to completely lose consciousness just by touching it.



Its Special Moves are sending countless parts of its body flying to steal the opponent's consciousness (Nightmare Rain), changing the shape of its right arm into a hammer and smashing the opponent with it (Fancy Fantasista), and piercing the opponent's Digicore with a laser fired from its left eye (Sweet Lovely Attack).

digimons.name: Shine Greymon
digimons.description: A Light Dragon Digimon which fights with the red-hot solar energy it accumulates. Its Special Moves are spreading its gigantic wings, concentrating that light energy to its utmost limit, then firing it (Glorious Burst), and mowing down the opponent with wings of glimmering light (Shining Blast). Also, it can summon the GeoGrey Sword, in which the power of Gaia is condensed, from the solid earth.

digimons.name: Shine Greymon: Burst Mode
digimons.description: A Shine Greymon that has temporarily reached the limits of its abilities through Burst Evolution, it is a unique form which wears an aura of solar-class high-energy flames. Its Special Moves are fusing its flaming shield and sword into a greatsword with explosively increased power (Corona Blaze Sword), and putting its body and soul into inducing a massive eruption (Final Shining Burst). Also, it can continuously fire incandescent flame shots (Torrid Weiss).

evolvesFrom.name: Rize Greymon
evolvesFrom.line: Rize Greymon[12] (with or without Shine Greymon, Chronomon Holy Mode, Geo Greymon, and Koromon)[7]

digimons.name: Shine Greymon: Ruin Mode
digimons.description: A form of Shine Greymon that unleashed its power through hatred when its comrades were defeated and its pride wounded. Its thirst for unlimited power has transformed its originally "positive" solar energy into "negative" dark energy. Its Special Moves have all been drastically enhanced by dark energy as well. However, if it draws out dark energy beyond its limits during battle, it will risk turning into a Digitama.

digimons.name: Shoutmon EX6
digimons.description: Shoutmon EX6 which has become the "Evolution Mode". It is formed from the DigiXros of evolved Digimon that included Omega Shoutmon, and it is considered to surpass Shoutmon X7 in defensive and flying ability because its body and wings shine gold and silver. The "Demolition Horn" on its left arm destroys any armor in addition to super-oscillating the instant it pierces it. Also, its right arm is equipped with the "Sol Calibur" sword. When Shooting Starmon is present, it unleashes a blow from its fist heavy enough to shatter a star using their Combined Special Move "Ryūsei Rock Damashī".

evolvesFrom.name: Omega Shoutmon
evolvesFrom.line: Omega Shoutmon[1] (with or without Zeke Greymon, Atlur Ballistamon, Yaeger Dorulumon and Raptor Sparrowmon[3], also including Shooting Starmon)[3]

digimons.name: Shoutmon X5B
digimons.description:
The "Pegasus-wargod Mode" formed when Beelzebumon granted further power to Shoutmon X5, which incarnated from five Digimon. Beelzebumon's firepower has added to the full power of Shoutmon X5, who boasts of being unmatched either on land or in the air, boosting its fighting strength exponentially.



Its "Burst Dash Stream", a series of Special Moves in which it cuts the opponent to pieces with "Burning Star Crusher", launches them with "Meteor Impact", and finishes them off with "Chaos Flare", pours raging waves of bold moves on the opponent in a flash with a three-step wave of attacks. This Pegasus becomes a galloping comet across the sky and makes sport of any kind of opponent with its godlike speed, and with its power, which should surely be praised as divine skill, it is like a wargod sent from heaven to destroy demons.

digimons.name: Shoutmon X5S
digimons.description:
The "Cosmic-fighter Mode" in which Shoutmon X5 digixrosed with the weaponized Spadamon. It possesses both powerful sword techniques and high flying ability.



By utilizing cosmic energy, it has acquired techniques called "Space Chakram", in which it launches a ring-shaped blade of light, and "Helio Slasher", where it clads the Star Sword in scorching heat like that of the sun, and slashes the enemy. Its Special Move is concentrating cosmic energy within Spadamon's blade and attacking (Cosmo Victory).

digimons.name: Shoutmon X7
digimons.description: The "Ardor-burst Mode" which digixrosed four Digimon with Shoutmon DX and attained further power. Its four passionate hearts burn within the "Gold Digizoid" that forms its body, and emit a divine aura. When Shoutmon X7 stands upon the battlefield, it is in the realization of a peaceful world, which is the entire goal of the Digimon that digixrosed into Shoutmon X7. If it carries those wishes in its heart, it is able to keep going forward without even yielding to any kind of attack. It overcomes close-combat battles with its "Xros Burning Rocker", in which it uses its passionate soul that longs for peace in the middle of the battlefield to light its McField-brand mic[N 1] in hellfire, then grandly swings it down, and dominates long-range battles with its "Double Flare Buster", in which it shoots all of its energy from the Zanahoria in its left hand. And when it clinches victory, or finds itself in a tight spot due to an opponent's fierce attacks, it seals the victory with its golden-hot "Seven Victorize" that concentrates its entire aura in its chest and fires it from its "V".

evolvesFrom.name: Omega Shoutmon
evolvesFrom.line: Omega Shoutmon[9] (with or without Zeke Greymon, Ballistamon, Dorulumon, Sparrowmon and Starmons[10][11] or Zeke Greymon and Shoutmon X5[12], or Ballistamon, Dorulumon, Starmons, and Sparrowmon[13])

digimons.name: Shoutmon X7: Superior Mode
digimons.description:
The "Awaking Mode" that Shoutmon X7 powers up into by turning several desires for peace into strength. The radiance of the aura overflowing from its Gold Digizoid has increased further, and it possesses wings of holy light. While carrying all hopes on its shoulders, it fights evil in order to guide the Digital World to peace, concentrating its passionate heart into the Burning Rocker.



Its Special Move is slashing its McField-brand mic, which has been transformed into a greatsword by concentrating energy, downward from overhead (Final Xros Blade). A single stroke of its sword leaves Digimon that possess a heart of justice unharmed, but as for Digimon with an evil heart, it completely resets their data, and it is said that they forcibly degenerate into a Digitama.

evolvesFrom.name: Omega Shoutmon
evolvesFrom.line: Omega Shoutmon (with Every Digimon from the Digital World[7])

digimons.name: Shroudmon
digimons.description:
A Demon Man Digimon that evolved when a certain Digimon tempered its body beyond its limit during unimaginable training. As a result of it just fighting repeatedly like an Asura, it came to be known as the "Fierce God". Its mind is already broken, and it has even forgotten the reason why it sought strength. It is a genuine combat enthusiast who loves fist fighting, and forces its defeated opponents to get back up.



Its Special Moves are using its iron fists, shrouded in an ominous aura, to dish out a combo attack too quick for the eye to see (Kishungouken), and reducing its surroundings to ashes with a roundhouse kick covered in flames (Gokuen Hakaishū). Its "Garaien Saiha", in which it fires black flaming energy shots from its held-out palms, boasts the single greatest firepower generated by a Digimon.

digimons.name: Siriusmon
digimons.description:
An Ultimate-level Light Dragon Digimon that is affiliated with the group of justice, the Virus Busters. Whenever it senses a voice crying for help or malice, even from far away, it will descend like a comet and bring down the enemy with the "Sylvia" composite cannon-blades equipped to both its arms. However, it is a kind-hearted being who brightens up everything around it such that if it senses a change of heart in its opponent during battle, it will lay down its arms and open up to them.



Its Special Moves are firing light beam shots from the Sylvia (Photon Blaster), and a blade of order with which, using its blade deployed in the forward position, it bisects the enemy (Cosmo Blade). In addition, it is said that the white flash from its "Breaquasar"—in which it slings a slash of starlight contained within its blade, as if chasing after the "Photon Blaster" that it fired, causing the combined shot of light and slash to explode in range of the enemy—looks like a meteor from remote areas. Also, even if the Sylvia get destroyed, it has a trump card up its sleeve, "Planet Knuckle", in which it packs its fists with life energy.

digimons.name: Skull Mammon
digimons.description: An Undead Digimon that was a Mammon, revived from ancient times, that continued to battle with Virus-species Digimon, resulting in its whole body being eaten away by a virus, leaving nothing but bones. Its survival instinct as a Vaccine is strong even in death, and in order to continue battling, it has lost all emotion and intelligence aside from its resolve to exterminate Viruses. The Digicore shining within its chest is undamaged, so it is able to maintain its vital functions even though its body has become nothing but bones, but if the bare Digicore is struck, then Skull Mammon would probably be at the edge of death. Its Special Move is rapidly spinning and then hurling one of its vertebra (Spiral Bone).

digimons.name: Skull Mammon (X-Antibody)
digimons.description:
An Undead Digimon that was a Mammon, revived from ancient times, that continued to battle with Virus-species Digimon, resulting in its whole body being eaten away by a virus, leaving nothing but bones. Its survival instinct as a Vaccine is strong even in death, and in order to continue battling, it has lost all emotion and intelligence aside from its resolve to exterminate Viruses. The Digicore shining within its chest is undamaged, so it is able to maintain its vital functions even though its body has become nothing but bones, but if the bare Digicore is struck, then Skull Mammon would probably be at the edge of death. Its Special Move is rapidly spinning and then hurling one of its vertebra (Spiral Bone).



The effect on Skull Mammon's Digicore due to the X-Antibody



Having continued to battle despite turning to bones, all that awaited it was actual death, but only its skeleton started to grow due to the influence of the X-Antibody. It stands completely on two legs, and its forelimbs have changed to being claw-shaped to tear up the enemy. Its skull developed abnormally and now has gigantic horns, becoming powerful weapons that inflict heavy damage to the enemy when it charges at them. It acquired its "Giant Crush Bone", where it rapidly spins the gigantic horns on its skull and charges, smashing the enemy to pieces.

digimons.name: Slash Angemon
digimons.description: A Power Digimon that commands the Powers and cuts through the vanguard in battle. As it persists in justice, it does not fear death. Along with the blades of its metal wings and hands, its entire body has gained a razor-sharp appearance, and it is surely an Angel Warrior created in order to battle wicked beings. Its Signature Move is "Holy Espada". Its Special Move is charging at the opponent with staggering momentum, cutting them to pieces with the blades covering its body (Heaven's Ripper).

evolvesFrom.name: Kyukimon
evolvesFrom.line: Kyukimon[1] (with or without Piccolomon or Giromon)[10]

evolvesFrom.name: Silphymon
evolvesFrom.line: Silphymon (with Megalo Growmon or Were Garurumon (X-Antibody))[18]

digimons.name: Slayerdramon
digimons.description: A Dragon Man Digimon whose body is clad in Chrome Digizoid scale armour. It is said that its form is one that can only be attained by those who complete the training that is called the "Trial of the Four Great Dragons", which can only be challenged by Dragon Digimon. It carries the extensible greatsword "Fragarach", and has mastered its original ultimate fencing technique, "Ryūzanken". There are three forms within Ryūzanken, from the first to the third, and the first form, "Tenryūzanha", is driving its sword, accelerated with a spin of its body, vertically through the opponent's skull, cutting them in half. The second form, "Shouryūzanpa", is releasing a dragon wave refined by its sword and directed from the bottom part to the top, slaying the opponent just from the sword's pressure. The third form, "Kouryūzanba", is stepping up close to the opponent and curling Fragarach around them, shaving off their whole body with the entwined sword blade.

digimons.name: Sleipmon
digimons.description: A Holy Knight Digimon which is one of the Digital World's guardians, the "Royal Knights". While most of the Royal Knights are Human Digimon, it has a bestial silhouette which could be called bizarre. Its whole body is clad in an armor of the "Red Digizoid" which boasts great defensive power, so even Ultimate Digimon are unlikely to be able to easily damage Sleipmon. Its six legs possess unsurpassed mobility, and it is capable of instantaneous, high-speed movements that its thick build would not suggest. Sleipmon acts as a guardian of the super-ancient ruins which sleep below the thick ice of the Digital World's north pole, since it is said that essential program data which concerns the creation of Digimon is sealed within these ruins. Its Special Moves are incandescent arrows of light fired from the sacred crossbow Múspellsheimr held in its left hand (Bifröst), and using the sacred shield Niflheimr in its right hand to lower the temperature of its climate and generate a blizzard (Odin's Breath).

evolvesFrom.name: Crescemon

digimons.name: Sleipmon (X-Antibody)
digimons.description:
A Holy Knight Digimon which is one of the Digital World's guardians, the "Royal Knights". While most of the Royal Knights are Human Digimon, it has a bestial silhouette which could be called bizarre. Its whole body is clad in an armor of the "Red Digizoid" which boasts great defensive power, so even Ultimate Digimon are unlikely to be able to easily damage Sleipmon. Its six legs possess unsurpassed mobility, and it is capable of instantaneous, high-speed movements that its thick build would not suggest. Sleipmon acts as a guardian of the super-ancient ruins which sleep below the thick ice of the Digital World's north pole, since it is said that essential program data which concerns the creation of Digimon is sealed within these ruins.



The effect on Sleipmon's Digicore due to the X-Antibody



In addition to its six legs it had previously, it now possesses four arms after transformation, removing any delay between loading and firing and thus allowing it to shoot continuously while moving at instantaneous high-speed.



Its Special Move is firing light arrows enveloped in hellfire that burn everything to cinders from its "Kyūkyoku Sendokyū Einherjar", fused from the wings on its back (Surtr Brander). In addition, its "Niflheimr Arrest", absolute zero cold air generated by the sacred "Niflheimr" shields equipped on each pair of its arms, freezes the surface of the ground and brings all vital functions to a complete halt.

digimons.name: Spinomon
digimons.description: A Dinosaur Digimon that inhabits the green depths of the jungle. It boasts the greatest and strongest powers among the Dinosaur Digimon inhabiting the Digital World, and it is said that it possesses strength equal to that of Dinorexmon. Due to its extreme belligerence it leads a highly brutal existence, but the latest research has made it clear that it possesses astonishing intelligence. The blades on its back have become its greatest feature, and since they possess excellent defensive and offensive power, if it suffers a direct attack, the attacker is forced to suffer nearly fatal wounds. Its Special Moves are shooting off the blades on its back all at once (Sonic Slash Rain), and converting the metal accumulated within its body into plasma by superheating it up to 15000°, then firing it off (Blue Prominence). The blades on its back keep growing back in an inexhaustible supply, so don't count on it running out of ammo.

evolvesFrom.line: Jewelbeemon (with a Free or Data Attribute Perfect Digimon from the Vital Bracelet Digital Monster[4])

evolvesFrom.name: Lilimon
evolvesFrom.line: Lilimon (with a Virus Attribute Perfect Digimon from the Vital Bracelet Digital Monster[4])

digimons.name: Suijinmon
digimons.description: A Machine Digimon that possesses parts from both Justimon and Mugendramon. While the reason why these parts are being used is unknown, there is no doubt that it has great combat strength. Its Special Moves are "Accel Arm", where it grips and crushes the enemy with its power-type arm, and "Mugen Cannon", a technique shared with Mugendramon.

digimons.name: Surfimon
digimons.description: Although it is an Aquatic-species Digimon, it is a Digimon that has been improved so that it can move quickly, even out of water. Its pride is high and it has a lone wolf personality that hates schooling like fish. Its Special Moves are rotating the spikes growing over its body like that of a chainsaw to attack and defend simultaneously (Barrier Blade), and accelerating to the speed of light and charging with the "Dash Slider" hoverboard it projects from the third eye on its head (Lightning Cutter).

digimons.name: Susanoomon
digimons.description: Told of in Oriental legends, it is the strongest destructive god and the god which governs over regeneration. It is told that when the Network System descends into chaos, it will erase the existing system, and create a new one. Its Special Moves are slicing and stabbing everything in the world with the sword of light emanated from the "ZERO-ARMS: Orochi" (Ama-no-Habakiri), and an ultimate technique in which it points the sword of light (emanated from the ZERO-ARMS: Orochi) at the heavens, which then rain incessant bolts of lightning upon the ground (Yakusa-no-Ikazuchi).

digimons.name: Tactimon
digimons.description: A soldier Digimon that possesses a peerless sword called "Jatetsufūjin-maru". Within the Jatetsufūjin-maru is sealed a sinister power strong enough to split a star in two, so drawing this sword marks the collapse of a star. Therefore, Tactimon battles without drawing the sword, but even so, it exhibits the destructive force of its menace. If it stabs the ground once it generates an earthquake, if twice it awakens one hundred dead warriors, and if thrice it collapses the surrounding land with a shock wave. The Jatetsufūjin-maru, which conceals such power, is not a sword that just anyone can handle. From that alone can you understand the depth of Tactimon's true might. Even more than its merit as a soldier, it excels in strategy with plans which are even said to be, "ingenuity itself, as if gushing forth like a spring," so Tactimon's true merit is not in physical strength but in ingenuity. When Tactimon leads an army, the outcome has already been decided, and it is said that, "the victory has been decided before it even fought." Due to the various plans it has laid out, when Tactimon stands upon the battlefield it has already guaranteed its absolute advantage.

digimons.name: Takutoumon
digimons.description:
A God Man Digimon born from the data of a certain warrior from Chinese legend. It is a hero who despises deceiving others, and uses its sword to resolve actions that deviate from the path of righteousness. It frequently imposes its own sense of justice onto others, and since it does not even make the effort to explain itself again, it often fights alone.



It has abandoned dialogue with anyone else and remains extremely taciturn, possibly because it believes that one's own thoughts are enough as long as they make sense to oneself. When forced into a conservation with someone, Takutoumon's white mouse-shaped, karakuri pet "Paishū"[N 1] will speak on its behalf. As such, whenever Takutoumon speaks itself, it is limited to when it has something particularly important to say.



Also, its treasure tool "Bǎo Tǎ", which contains data from Shakamon, is housed within the gauntlet on its left palm, and since it can use this to seal away the opponent's fighting spirit, Takutoumon forces the Digimon that oppose it to become more docile.Its Special Moves are unleashing a blade of light from its swung treasure sword (Tenseizan), and projecting an enlarged Bǎo Tǎ above the opponent's head and dropping it on them, crushing them (Tettensaisai).

digimons.name: Takutoumon: Wrath Mode
digimons.description:
The form that Takutoumon boldly Mode Changes into when throwing itself into great battles. The Bǎo Tǎ has materialized into armor, its white mouse-shaped karakuri has transformed into a trident, and its appearance is a manifestation of the data of an "Eastern God" who is identified with a legendary warrior.



It amplifies its own power by releasing the vast amount of fighting spirit it had stolen and sealed within the Bǎo Tǎ all at once. However, it is an extremely aggressive and dangerous form that went into a state one can safely say is berserk as a result of gaining this immense power.



The Bǎo Tǎ, which is now its armor, not only protects its body, but can also be detached into smaller components and deployed as autonomous attack units for long-range shooting.



Its Special Move is a tricky slash attack where the detached Bǎo Tǎ disperse, and reflect the trajectory of the blade of light released from its trident (Ryūsen Rangeki). Its "Bishamon Hakkyoku Senjin" is both an offensive and defensive technique in which it uses all of the deployed Bǎo Tǎ units to form a defensive barrier while simultaneously firing a massive laser that can blast even mountains away.

digimons.name: Taotiemon
digimons.description:
An Oni Digimon whose body is covered in wool-like fur, wearing an object resembling a bronze ornament. While it is innocent like a child, it is an immature, cruel brat as a result.



It can be seen floating and moving through the skies over Jakeizan like a cloud. It is in a constant state of hunger—perhaps due to it having a bug somewhere—and attempts to voraciously devour any prey that catches its eye. When it preys, the ornament on its head opens wide, revealing its terrifying maw.



The talismans affixed to its head have confined it so that it can never leave Jakeizan. Because of this, it is thought to be a Digimon that has existed in the Eastern Digital World for a long time, just like Dijiangmon and the others, sealed away within the mountains by someone with immense power.



Its Special Move is sucking up prey with the enormous maw on its head, swallowing them whole (Kyūen Donkaku). Its "Etoga", in which it spits out and sprays leftovers from the vast amounts of data it has devoured, completely dissolves the opponent's body. Although its "Tōkibaku", where it triggers an explosion by releasing the power amassed in its body from overeating all at once, is immensely powerful, the recoil causes it to fall into a state of hunger even greater than usual.

digimons.name: Tiger Vespamon
digimons.description: A Cyborg Digimon that defends the mysterious "aerial, covert honey base, Royal Base". Vespamon boasts an astounding degree of stamina that could not be imagined from its slight and thorny silhouette, and it never stops moving during combat. The best of the best, said to be the top 0.08%, are inducted into the "covert honey corps, Royal Commando", and awarded a codename. Its codename "Tiger" comes from the fact that it is by far the best in solo combat, and it wields twin blades shaped like tiger fangs, the "covert honey arms, Royal Meister". Its Special Move is stinging the opponent with the twin blades, Royal Meister (Mach Stinger V).[N 1]

digimons.name: Titamon
digimons.description: The titan of revenge, Titamon, was born from the hatred of the Digimon defeated by the Olympos XII in battles over the sovereignty of the Digital World. It holds the alias of "One-Man Division", and bearing the inexhaustible energy of its hatred within its gigantic body, it runs through the battlefield seeking the heads of the Olympos XII. Its large arms are covered in a multitude of skulls, which are all data of the power it has stolen from the enemies it has defeated so far. As its gigantic sword "Zanjintou" is a bone sword carved from Skull Greymon's bones, the hatred filling the sword makes a low growl. The swing of its Special Move, "Konpaku Shingeki", slides through the opponent's armor and body with its blade, reaching their Digicore unhindered and chopping it up. If one takes this technique head on, they'll never be able to recover. Its "Genjin Mukon", which eviscerates the opponent, causes them to fall into a hallucination that they are still being harrowed even after the Zanjintou is pulled out, so that they don't stop suffering until their spirit dies. Its "Koou Meigun" summons shades based on the skulls on both of its arms, which overrun the enemy's forces as an undead legion. This is the reason Titamon is called the "One-Man Division", and it is treated as if it were a legion despite being a single being because it is able to instantly summon a mighty host.

digimons.name: Tonosama Mamemon
digimons.description: A Mamemon that read jidaigeki video data and mutated. Easygoing and always cheerful, it drags around its hakama, which it has difficulty walking in, and constantly falls over, rolls, and gets tangled up in it, making onlookers laugh and bringing joy to their hearts. It is magnanimous in that it welcomes any Digimon that comes to its castle, but once a Digimon that disturbs the area around the castle appears, it will... punish them without mercy... while rolling. In its Special Move "Appare Zakura", which is unleashed from its fan, it judges the enemy's wrongdoing with cherry blossoms that scatter mysteriously, and causes them to lose the will to fight. However, "Appare Zakura" is easily affected by the wind, and will sometimes fail to reach the enemy when the headwinds are blowing against it. Also, it has the splendid "Sensugaeshi", which is capable of repelling any attack from the enemy.

digimons.name: Tyrant Kabuterimon
digimons.description: The "King of Bugs" which governs all Insect Digimon. Its stronghold, the "Under Forest", exists deep underneath the darkest forest, and it is said that it only moves at night. It is able to manipulate every Insect Digimon at will, so it almost never fights in person. Due to the high density Chrome Digizoid which compose its shell, it is thought to be impossible for ordinary Digimon to even scratch it. The red-hot explosion which it emits from its entire body (Shine of Bee) is impossible to defend against, and instantly reduces all of its opponents to ash. Also, its "Bee Cyclone" summons all of its insect followers, to construct an impenetrable wall of bugs.

evolvesFrom.name: Metallife Kuwagamon
evolvesFrom.line: Metallife Kuwagamon[2][7] (with or without Okuwamon, Okuwamon (X-Antibody)[2] or Chimairamon)[7]

digimons.name: Ulforce V-dramon
digimons.description: A Holy Knight Digimon based on a legend that only appears within a certain "Prophecy", handed down from the ancient Digital World. In that "Prophecy" is written the appearance of the "Royal Knights", the guardian deities of the Network, and based on the "Prophecy", it is said that the Digimon that are called the "Royal Knights" will assemble at the time of the Digital World's greatest crisis. Ulforce V-dramon possesses the swiftest speed among the "Royal Knights", and there is no one that can follow its movements. Also, its body is wrapped in holy armor made of the lightest rare metal "Blue Chrondigizoit", which is rare even among Chrome Digizoid, so it can cleave the sky and split the earth. It can extend weapons and a shield from the "V Bracelets" equipped to both of its arms. Its Special Move is a beam which strafes across from the "V"-shaped armor on its chest (Shining V-Force).

digimons.description:
A Holy Knight Digimon based on a legend that only appears within a certain "Prophecy", handed down from the ancient Digital World. In that "Prophecy" is written the appearance of the "Royal Knights", the guardian deities of the Network, and based on the "Prophecy", it is said that the Digimon that are called the "Royal Knights" will assemble at the time of the Digital World's greatest crisis. Ulforce V-dramon possesses the swiftest speed among the "Royal Knights", and there is no one that can follow its movements. Also, its body is wrapped in holy armor made of the lightest rare metal "Blue Chrondigizoit", which is rare even among Chrome Digizoid, so it can cleave the sky and split the earth. It can extend the "Ulforce Saber" and the "Tense-great Shield" from the "V Bracelets" equipped to both of its arms. Its Special Move is a beam which strafes across from the "V"-shaped armor on its chest (Shining V-Force).



The effect on Ulforce V-dramon's Digicore due to the X-Antibody



The "Ulforce", its own ultimate force, has been drawn out further, even more so than its swift speed. The Ulforce also has remarkable healing abilities, allowing it to instantly self-recover from any damage. Even if you catch sight of Ulforce V-dramon and attack it, it will immediately counterattack with 100% of its power.

digimons.name: Ultimate Brachimon
digimons.description: A Cyborg Digimon who boasts of being the largest on land, and the heaviest. The boosters equipped to its back thrust downwards, supporting the weight of its colossal body, and are used when moving. It has undergone very heavy-duty remodeling, and while its moving speed is by no means fast, its bulky armor makes it unnecessary for it to evade the enemy's attacks, and it is impossible to withstand the recoil of its superweapon, which is fired from the huge gunport on its chest, without being Ultimate Brachimon's weight. Its Special Moves are detonating the energy within its body, and sending out a blast from the huge gunport on its chest (Ultimate Blast), and striking with its gigantic tail, shaking even the earth (Ultimate Quake).

digimons.name: Ultimate Chaosmon
digimons.description: A Digimon born from the fusion of the four bodies of Bancho Leomon, Darkdramon, Valdurmon, and Sleipmon. Due to the strain from fusing four mighty powers all at once, most of the strength which had retained a balance of power collected in its arms, which took on a gigantic size as a result. Also, it is unable to store its Digicores within its body, so the two of them manifest bare on its shoulders. Its power, which it is unable to suppress, flows from its whole body as if it was leaking out, and it's said that Child Digimon and below aren't even able to approach it just due to that power. Its Special Moves are its "Broken Destroy", which boasts the might to easily crush even larger Digimon, and releasing the energy of its Digicores all at once, then firing it at the opponent (Ultima Burst).

digimons.name: Valdurmon
digimons.description: A mythical Holy Bird Digimon that inhabits the stratosphere 40 km up in the sky. It possesses six gigantic wings, and when it spreads them to their widest its wingspan reaches as much as 30 m. According to legend it is the guardian of the sky, and it is told that it is an ancient Digimon that has existed since the creation of the Digital World. Valdurmon's feathers normally emit the holy light of its "Purge Shine", cladding its body in a barrier that 100% invalidates any attacks with an evil will. Its Special Move is amplifying the purifying light of "Purge Shine" to its maximum and emitting it (Aurora Undulation). This technique is said to have the power to pulverize even a star, and because it is emitted at the speed of light, it is nearly impossible to evade.

evolvesFrom.name: Tyilinmon
evolvesFrom.line: Tyilinmon (with Valkyrimon, Ancient Irismon, and Lucemon)[5]

digimons.name: Victory Greymon
digimons.description: A subspecies of War Greymon, whose body is clad in armor of the super-metal "Chrome Digizoid", it easily wields its gigantic sword, and is the "Dragon Warrior of Heroes" that fights against its opponents with unique sword techniques. Its Special Moves are wielding its gigantic crushing sword "Dramon Breaker" to perform a heroic sword technique in which it strikes the opponent, instead of slashing, pulverizing them (Dramon Breaker), and splits the Dramon Breaker and equipping the pieces to its arms, taking all the energy within the atmosphere and concentrating it into the tips of its sword, then firing it (Trident Gaia). Also, it has a unique sword technique named "Victory Charge" which allows it to reflect back an opponent's attack with its gigantic sword. In addition, Victory Greymon possesses an evolutionary code that differs from Digimon that were naturally born in the Digital World, and it is thought that it is a Digimon that evolved from a Digitama that was produced due to artificial data intervention.

digimons.name: Volcanicdramon
digimons.description:
A Digimon said to be a dragon that swims in magma, it is thought to live in a place so deep underground that not even Digimon that move about there can reach it. According to some researchers, there are few who argue that it might have been Volcanicdramon that supported the world from deep beneath the ground ever since the Digital World was created. Should Volcanicdramon ever rise to the surface, it may be that some kind of crisis is occurring in the Digital World.



Its Special Move is spewing scorching-hot flames from its mouth (Volcanic Flare). The land incinerated by Volcanicdramon is never restored, forever turning it into an uninhabitable wasteland. In addition, it has "Glide Blaze", in which it rams the enemy while sending out scorching flames hotter than even magma from its whole body.

digimons.name: Voltobautamon
digimons.description:
The vilest, most wicked Digimon through which the "Grudgeful Hand", born from the malice data that overflows the Dark Area, served as the source of evil that forced Piemon to absorb Vamdemon. It has neither Piemon's nor Vamdemon's sense of self, and acts according to the Grudgeful Hand's will. Its intention is to eradicate light so that it can corrode the world with darkness.



Its Special Move is using magic to make copies of the "Spiedini" swords it carries on its waist and sending them flying (Palazzi Valzer). It takes pleasure in its methods of slowly torturing the enemy and causing them to be in agony, and finally ends their life by sending them flying from all directions simultaneously as its grand finale. Also, it has "Quarzione", in which the bullets fired from its two "Ala di Pollo" guns lodge themselves inside the enemy's body, attacking and annihilating them from within.

digimons.name: War Greymon (X-Antibody)
digimons.description:
The strongest dragon warrior whose body is clad in armor of the super-metal "Chrome Digizoid", it is the ultimate form of Greymon-species Digimon. Though it differs from the gigantic figure seen in Greymon-species Digimon, and has the form of a Man-type, it has rapidly improved its speed and power, and it is likely impossible to defeat it with the attacks of a Perfect Digimon. The "Dramon Killers" equipped to both of its arms exhibit immense power against Dramon-type Digimon, while simultaneously being double-edged swords that put its own life at great risk. Also, when the shells equipped on its back unite into one, they become the "Brave Shield", which is a shield of the strongest toughness. It is said that the moment that a true hero among veteran warriors awakens to its own mission, it evolves into War Greymon. Its Special Move is taking all of the energy within the atmosphere and concentrating it into one spot, then firing it as an extremely dense, high-temperature energy shot (Gaia Force).



The effect on War Greymon's Digicore due to the X-Antibody



Because of its mission as a true hero, it must have 100% success in battle. It has imparted the strongest toughness of the "Brave Shield" to the "Dramon Killers", leading to it possessing perfected equipment of unified offense and defense. Due to its fighting style, in which it instantly plunges into the heart of the enemy with the vernier it has equipped to its back, which boast explosive acceleration at the expense of it being able to fly for extended periods, it has certainly become the strongest form of land combat Digimon, a "Land War Hero". Evasion of its point-blank attack "Gaia Force ZERO", where it instantly fires its Special Move "Gaia Force" at the heart of the enemy, seems impossible. Furthermore, its "Afterburst", which accelerates its attacks with its vernier applied to the "Dramon Killers", is also a one-hit knockout technique.

digimons.name: Xiangpengmon
digimons.description:
A Holy Bird Digimon referred to as a phantom, it has a body large enough to cover a mountain. It usually sleeps peacefully at the depths of the Net Ocean. While sleeping, Xiangpengmon's data regulates the surrounding environment. Whenever it senses another area of the ocean where the environment has deteriorated, it will awaken, move there to improve that environment, and then return to sleep. Because of its huge size, each time it leaps from the surface and flaps its wings, it shakes the atmosphere, causing all kinds of abnormal weather. Also, while it is in the ocean, several Aquatic Digimon use the crevices all over its body as a nest. In addition, these Aquatic Digimon provide Xiangpengmon with energy little by little, forming a symbiotic relationship that supplies it with nourishment while it sleeps.



None of its Special Moves target individuals; they are all wide-ranging, specialized techniques that indiscriminately annihilate a large number of enemies. There is "Raikōben", in which it generates thunderclouds and looses countless thunderbolts over the target area where the enemy is, "Shinsaiga", wherein it fires the spears on both of its wings from high above to shatter the earth, and "Tensei Kaikai", where it hurls an enormous sphere created from a large amount of seawater towards the ground.

digimons.name: Xuanwumon
digimons.description: One of the Four Holy Beasts who protect the Digital World, it guards the North and uses phantasmagoric water techniques. It is a legendary being like the other Four Holy Beast Digimon, and its strength is said to equal that of a god. It is the oldest of the Four Holy Beast Digimon, and possesses a gentle personality. Common to the Four Holy Beast Digimon are the possession of four shining eyes, and twelve Digicores floating outside of their body. Normally there is one Digicore per body, and it is not exposed outside of the body except with the Undead types or the greatest of the Ultimate class. Its Special Move is displaying an illusion which generates a dark mist around the opponent, destroying their spirit (Mugen).

digimons.name: Yggdrasill_7D6
digimons.description: "7D6" is an avatar created by the mysterious host computer "Yggdrasill", who rules over all of the "Digital World" on the Network. Although it fires its "Crystal no Hahen" and "Kyodaina Crystal", and has the ability of "Jikoshūfuku", there are many unidentified details of its body.

digimons.name: Yihumon
digimons.description:
A Beast Man Digimon that can control the wind, it has the body of a tiger with great eagle-like wings sprouting from its arms. It is extremely brutal and cunning. It has a malice-filled nature.



It inhabits a vast mountainous area known as Jakeizan, situated within the continent of the Eastern Digital World, and refuses to emerge from the dark mountains where evil spirits dwell. For that reason, it has taken a long time to discover Yihumon, but according to observed data, it is very likely that this Digimon is one that has existed since the earliest days of the Eastern Digital World's emergence.



The yellow talismans attached all over its body are similar to those on Dijiangmon, and have the word "Shikyoju" inscribed on them, along with data related to ancient seals and barriers.



Its fighting style specializes in palm strikes and kicking techniques with Kung Fu-like movements, and every single move it makes harbors the power of the wind, so each blow is extremely swift and heavy, inflicting pain on the opponents it faces.



Its Special Moves are unleashing sharp slashes along with a roundhouse kick (Zankū), and in its "Jinba Oroshi", where it fires countless feathers by flapping its wings, the feathers are laced with a poison that slows down the movements of the parts of the body that they pierce. Finally, its "Kyūga Randanshū", which it unleashes the instant the opponent creates an opening, is a secret technique where it catches them in a tornado, and delivers a frenzied attack while riding the winds.

digimons.name: Z'd Garurumon
digimons.description: A subspecies of Metal Garurumon, the final form of Garurumon, it is the ultimate beast tank Digimon equipped with the ultimate superdreadnought-class weapon, "Z'd Hou". Z'd Garurumon's weapons and ammunition are equipped throughout its body, so its physical strength isn't consumed, and it can sustain a rain of bullets for a long duration. The four Laser Sights on its snout have been improved for its ammunition, and are now capable of locking onto hundreds of objects. Its Special Move is mowing down the opponent by simultaneously firing its ultimate weapon Z'd Hou alongside all of the other weapons throughout its body (Fullmetal Blaze). Also, it can spray explosive energy from its mouth (Blowback Breath). In addition, Z'd Garurumon possesses an evolutionary code that differs from Digimon that were naturally born in the Digital World, and it is thought that it is a Digimon that evolved from a Digitama that was produced due to artificial data intervention.

digimons.name: Zanbamon
digimons.description:
A Demon Man Digimon which has the appearance of a horse-riding warrior. It is a courageous warrior who reigns as the general of the Musyamon corps. Although it is a general, it voluntarily stands at the head of its own army, and prefers fighting styles which cut into the enemy. Its lower half is fused with its horse in order to move more easily about the battlefield, so that even during a pitched battle it is able to swing its sword without losing its balance. Its Special Move is using the gigantic zanbato "Ryūzan-maru" it holds in its right hand to unleash its "Uchikubi Gokumon", which has the power to cut through the opponent's armor with its gigantic blade, regardless of whether they are defending themselves. Its "Jūmonji Giri" is an attack it unleashes using the youtou it holds in its left hand, which releases a shock wave, generated by the nimble swings of its slender blade, that can cut the opponent apart crosswise.
Zanbamon was adopted from a winning Digimon entry in the "Bandai-Town FAX Service Digimon Illustration Contest" which belonged to Mr. Arata Hirayama from Chiba prefecture.

digimons.name: Zeed Millenniumon
digimons.description: Flying freely between space and time, it is a king of evil that is still trying to destroy all eras and worlds. Although a Digimon will become a Digitama if defeated in battle, there are very rare occasions when it has instead been reborn from within the corpse of its data. According to one theory, when Millenniumon died in a furious battle, the dark soul it possessed was reborn as Zeed Millenniumon. Also, as for the bands which wrap around Zeed Millenniumon, it is said that they are like chains which suppress its abilities, but it is unknown who could cast such a spell on Zeed Millenniumon.[N 1][N 2] However, it is foretold that if it is released from this spell, it will rain unfathomable destruction upon the Digital World. Its Special Move is "Time Destroyer", which consigns hostile opponents to oblivion across space and time. So far, no one who has been brushed off by this technique has returned alive from space and time.

digimons.name: Zhuqiaomon
digimons.description: One of the Four Holy Beasts who protect the Digital World, it guards the South and manipulates incandescent flames. Reigning since the age of myth, its existence has passed into legend, and it is extremely difficult to track down. Also, it is difficult to overthrow with the power of an ordinary Ultimate, and its power is set as the highest authority among other Digimon, so it is surely the epitome of a god. Zhuqiaomon's temperament is the roughest among the Four Holy Beast Digimon, and it incinerates anything that approaches it without reason. Its Special Move is a swirl of flames comparable to the prominences which jet out with a solar eruption (Kouen).
